q.en: Is it bad manners to say no to a grown-up?
q.hg: Kya kisi bade ko 'no' bolna badtameezi hai?

a.en: No. Being polite is good, and you should listen to grown-ups about things like homework and bedtime. But if a grown-up touches you in a way you do not like, asks you to keep a secret, or asks you to do something that feels wrong, you can say 'No'. Then tell another grown-up you trust. You will not be in trouble for that.
a.hg: Nahi. Polite rehna achhi baat hai, aur homework aur sone ke time jaisi cheezon mein tumhe badon ki baat maanni chahiye. Par agar koi bada tumhe aise touch kare jo tumhe pasand nahi, koi baat secret rakhne ko bole, ya aisa kuch karne ko bole jo galat lage, toh tum 'no' bol sakte ho. Phir kisi doosre bharose wale bade ko batao. Iske liye tumhe daant nahi padegi.

q.en: I told a grown-up about my problem, but they did not listen. What now?
q.hg: Maine ek bade ko apni problem batayi, par unhone suna hi nahi. Ab kya karun?

a.en: You did the right thing by telling. Sometimes grown-ups are busy or do not understand the first time. Tell them again, or tell another grown-up: a teacher, nani, dada, an aunt or a neighbour you trust. Keep telling until someone helps. You can also call 1098. It is a free phone number for children who need help.
a.hg: Tumne batakar bilkul sahi kiya. Kabhi-kabhi bade busy hote hain ya pehli baar mein samajh nahi paate. Unhe phir se batao, ya kisi doosre bade ko batao: teacher, nani, dada, mausi ya koi neighbour jispe tumhe bharosa ho. Tab tak batate raho jab tak koi help na kare. Tum 1098 pe bhi call kar sakte ho. Yeh un bacchon ke liye free phone number hai jinhe help chahiye.

q.en: I am scared to ask questions in class because others may laugh. What should I do?
q.hg: Mujhe class mein sawaal poochne se darr lagta hai kyunki doosre hans sakte hain. Main kya karun?

a.en: Asking a question means you are thinking, and usually two or three other children were wondering the same thing. If speaking in front of everyone feels hard, ask the teacher after class, or write the question on a slip of paper and hand it over. You can start with, 'Ma'am, I did not understand this part.' If someone laughs, it says nothing about you. Good teachers like questions.
a.hg: Sawaal poochne ka matlab hai tum soch rahe ho, aur usually do-teen aur bacche bhi wahi cheez soch rahe hote hain. Agar sabke saamne bolna mushkil lage, toh class ke baad teacher se pooch lo, ya sawaal ek parchi pe likhkar de do. Tum aise start kar sakte ho, 'Ma'am, mujhe yeh part samajh nahi aaya.' Agar koi hanse, toh isse tumhare baare mein kuch prove nahi hota. Achhe teachers ko sawaal pasand hote hain.

q.en: My best friend and I had a huge fight. How do I make up?
q.hg: Mera aur mere best friend ka bahut bada jhagda ho gaya. Patch-up kaise karun?

a.en: Give it a little time so that both of you cool down, then make the first move. It does not mean you lost. Say it face to face or in a short message: 'I miss you. Can we talk?' Listen to their side fully. Say sorry for your part and name it, for example, 'Sorry I shouted at you in front of everyone.' Tell them what hurt you using 'I felt'. Agree on one thing you will both do differently. If they need more time, respect that.
a.hg: Thoda time do taaki tum dono cool down ho jao, phir first move tum karo. Iska matlab yeh nahi ki tum haar gaye. Face to face ya ek short message mein bolo: 'I miss you. Baat kar sakte hain?' Unki poori side suno. Apne part ke liye sorry bolo aur woh galti clearly batao, jaise, 'Sorry, maine sabke saamne tumpe chilla diya.' 'Mujhe aisa laga' bolkar batao ki tumhe kis baat se hurt hua. Ek aisi cheez decide karo jo tum dono aage alag tareeke se karoge. Agar unhe aur time chahiye, toh usse respect karo.

q.en: How do I start an embarrassing conversation with my mom or dad?
q.hg: Mummy ya papa se koi embarrassing baat kaise shuru karun?

a.en: Warn them that it is awkward; that one line does half the work. Try: 'I need to ask you something and I feel shy. Please don't laugh or get angry.' Choose a private, unhurried moment, like a walk, a drive or while cooking together, when you do not have to look at each other the whole time. If talking is too hard, write a note or a text. If your parent reacts badly, wait a day and try again, or go to another adult you trust, such as an older sibling, an aunt, a teacher or a counsellor.
a.hg: Unhe pehle hi bata do ki baat awkward hai; yeh ek line aadha kaam kar deti hai. Try karo: 'Mujhe aapse kuch poochna hai aur mujhe sharam aa rahi hai. Please hansna ya gussa mat hona.' Koi private, fursat wala moment choose karo, jaise walk pe, car mein ya saath cooking karte hue, jab poore time ek-doosre ki taraf dekhna na pade. Agar bolna bahut mushkil ho, toh note ya text likh do. Agar parent ka reaction achha na ho, toh ek din ruk ke phir try karo, ya kisi aur trusted adult ke paas jao, jaise bada bhai-behen, mausi, teacher ya counsellor.

q.en: My friends call me boring whenever I refuse. How do I say no without losing them?
q.hg: Jab bhi main mana karun, dost mujhe boring bolte hain. Unhe khoye bina 'no' kaise bolun?

a.en: Say no to the plan, not to the people: 'I'm not doing that, but I'm in for the movie.' Keep it short and do not over-explain. A joke or a ready reason can help, such as 'Not my scene' or 'My mom would end me.' If you find one friend who is also not keen, stand together; pressure drops sharply when you are not alone. Friends may tease for a few minutes and then move on. If a group drops you only because you would not do something risky, that was membership with conditions, not friendship.
a.hg: 'No' plan ko bolo, logon ko nahi: 'Mujhe woh nahi karna, par movie ke liye main in hoon.' Short rakho aur zyada explain mat karo. Koi joke ya ready reason kaam aa sakta hai, jaise 'Not my scene' ya 'Mummy mujhe chhodegi nahi.' Agar tumhe ek bhi aisa dost mile jiska bhi mann nahi hai, toh saath khade ho jao; jab tum akele nahi hote toh pressure bahut kam ho jata hai. Dost kuch minute chidhayenge aur phir move on kar jayenge. Agar koi group tumhe sirf isliye drop kar de ki tumne koi risky kaam nahi kiya, toh woh conditions wali membership thi, dosti nahi.

q.en: How can I tell if someone is manipulating me or genuinely cares?
q.hg: Kaise pata chale ki koi mujhe manipulate kar raha hai ya sach mein care karta hai?

a.en: Look at what happens when you say no. A person who cares may be disappointed, but accepts it. A manipulator keeps working on you: guilt ('after all I did for you'), speed ('decide now'), secrecy ('don't tell anyone'), threats, or making you doubt your memory. Other signs: you feel anxious before meeting them, you apologise constantly, and you hide things from people you trust. Describe it to a parent, teacher, counsellor or friend; an outside view often makes the pattern obvious. If there are threats or blackmail, or someone older pushes for photos, meetings or secrecy, tell a trusted adult now or call 1098. For online threats, call 1930.
a.hg: Dekho ki jab tum 'no' bolte ho tab kya hota hai. Jise care hai woh disappoint ho sakta hai, par accept kar leta hai. Manipulator tumpe kaam karta rehta hai: guilt ('maine tumhare liye itna kuch kiya'), speed ('abhi decide karo'), secrecy ('kisi ko mat batana'), threats, ya aisi baatein jisse tum apni hi memory pe doubt karne lago. Doosre signs: usse milne se pehle tumhe anxiety hoti hai, tum constantly sorry bolte rehte ho, aur tum trusted logon se cheezein chhupane lage ho. Poori baat parent, teacher, counsellor ya kisi dost ko batao; bahar se dekhne pe pattern aksar clear dikh jata hai. Agar dhamki ya blackmail ho, ya koi badi umar ka insaan photos, milne ya secret rakhne ke liye pressure daale, toh abhi kisi trusted adult ko batao ya 1098 pe call karo. Online dhamki ke liye 1930 pe call karo.

q.en: Someone I like said no to me and I can't stop feeling hurt. What do I do?
q.hg: Jo mujhe pasand hai usne mujhe 'no' bol diya aur mera hurt kam hi nahi ho raha. Main kya karun?

a.en: Feeling hurt, embarrassed or even angry after a no is normal, and it fades. Accept the answer the first time: 'Okay, thanks for being honest.' Do not keep messaging, ask their friends to convince them, show up where they are or talk badly about them. Repeated contact after a clear no can amount to harassment or stalking, which the law treats as an offence. Give yourself distance, talk to a friend and let time work. Their no is not a verdict on your worth. If the low feeling lasts for weeks or you think of hurting yourself, talk to a trusted adult or call Tele-MANAS on 14416.
a.hg: 'No' sunne ke baad hurt, embarrassed ya gussa tak feel hona normal hai, aur yeh dheere-dheere fade ho jata hai. Answer ko pehli baar mein hi accept kar lo: 'Okay, honest hone ke liye thanks.' Baar-baar message mat karo, unke doston se convince karne ko mat bolo, jahan woh hon wahan ja-jaake khade mat ho aur unki burai mat karo. Clear 'no' ke baad baar-baar contact karna harassment ya stalking maana ja sakta hai, jise law offence maanta hai. Khud ko thodi distance do, kisi dost se baat karo aur time ko apna kaam karne do. Unki 'no' tumhari worth pe koi verdict nahi hai. Agar low feeling hafton tak rahe ya khud ko hurt karne ke khayal aayein, toh kisi trusted adult se baat karo ya Tele-MANAS ko 14416 pe call karo.

q.en: How do I know if a health video or website is telling the truth?
q.hg: Kaise pata chale ki koi health video ya website sach bata rahi hai?

a.en: Check five things. Who made it: a named, qualified doctor or a recognised health body, or an anonymous page? What evidence does it give? Is it selling something? When was it written? Do other reliable sources say the same? Government health sites, the World Health Organization, major hospitals and registered doctors are safer starting points than influencers or forwards. Treat words like 'miracle', 'guaranteed' and 'secret' as warnings. For anything about your own body, use what you read to prepare questions and then ask a doctor. Online information cannot examine you.
a.hg: Paanch cheezein check karo. Isse kisne banaya: naam wale, qualified doctor ya kisi recognised health body ne, ya kisi anonymous page ne? Yeh kya evidence deta hai? Kya yeh kuch bech raha hai? Yeh kab likha gaya? Kya doosre reliable sources bhi yahi bolte hain? Influencers ya forwards ke comparison mein government health sites, World Health Organization, bade hospitals aur registered doctors start karne ke liye zyada safe hain. 'Miracle', 'guaranteed' aur 'secret' jaise words ko warning samjho. Apni body se judi kisi bhi baat ke liye, jo padha hai usse sawaal ready karo aur phir doctor se poocho. Online information tumhe examine nahi kar sakti.

q.en: I have a problem in my private parts and I'm too embarrassed to tell a doctor. What do I say?
q.hg: Mere private parts mein ek problem hai aur doctor ko batane mein mujhe bahut sharam aati hai. Main kya bolun?

a.en: Say exactly that: 'Doctor, I have a problem in my genital area and I feel embarrassed talking about it.' Doctors see these problems daily, and nothing you describe will be new to them. Use plain words such as penis, testicles, vulva, vagina or anus, and say what you notice (itching, pain, discharge, a lump, a smell) and since when. You can write it on your phone and hand it over. Where available, you may ask for a doctor of the gender you are comfortable with. Do not treat it with creams or tablets suggested by friends or videos; delay and wrong medicines make many conditions harder to treat.
a.hg: Bilkul yahi bol do: 'Doctor, mere genital area mein ek problem hai aur iske baare mein baat karne mein mujhe sharam aa rahi hai.' Doctors aisi problems roz dekhte hain, aur tum jo bhi bataoge woh unke liye naya nahi hoga. Seedhe words use karo, jaise penis, testicles, vulva, vagina ya anus, aur batao ki tumhe kya notice ho raha hai (khujli, dard, discharge, gaanth, smell) aur kab se. Tum isse phone pe likhkar unhe dikha bhi sakte ho. Jahan available ho, tum us gender ke doctor ke liye bol sakte ho jiske saath tum comfortable ho. Doston ya videos ki batayi cream ya tablets se iska ilaaj mat karo; delay aur galat medicines se kai conditions ka treatment aur mushkil ho jata hai.

q.en: Will the doctor tell my parents what I say?
q.hg: Kya doctor meri batayi baatein mere parents ko bata denge?

a.en: Doctors are expected to keep your information private, and you can ask at the start what will be shared and with whom. If you are an adult, your consent is normally needed before anything is told to family. If you are under 18, a parent or guardian is usually involved in consent for treatment, and the law requires doctors to report sexual abuse or sexual activity involving a minor, so they cannot promise complete secrecy about that. They may also act if your life is in danger. Asking these questions up front is sensible, and it should not stop you from getting care.
a.hg: Doctors se expect kiya jata hai ki woh tumhari information private rakhein, aur tum shuru mein hi pooch sakte ho ki kya aur kise bataya jayega. Agar tum adult ho, toh family ko kuch bhi batane se pehle normally tumhara consent zaroori hota hai. Agar tum 18 se kam ho, toh treatment ke consent mein usually parent ya guardian involved hote hain, aur law ke hisaab se doctors ko kisi minor ke saath sexual abuse ya sexual activity report karni hoti hai, isliye woh us baare mein complete secrecy ka promise nahi kar sakte. Agar tumhari life danger mein ho, tab bhi woh action le sakte hain. Ye sawaal pehle hi pooch lena samajhdaari hai, aur iski wajah se care lene se rukna nahi chahiye.

q.en: My friend told me a secret about being hurt and made me promise not to tell. What should I do?
q.hg: Mere dost ne mujhe apne saath ho rahi kisi buri baat ka secret bataya aur promise liya ki main kisi ko na bataun. Mujhe kya karna chahiye?

a.en: Some secrets are not safe to keep. If your friend is being abused, threatened, blackmailed or is thinking of self-harm, getting adult help is loyalty, not betrayal. Tell your friend first: 'I care about you too much to keep this to myself. Let's tell someone together.' Go to an adult you both trust, such as a parent, teacher or counsellor, or call 1098 (under 18), 181 (women), Tele-MANAS on 14416, or 112 in an emergency. Do not confront the person causing harm, and do not spread it among friends. Next time, avoid promising secrecy before you know what the secret is.
a.hg: Kuch secrets rakhna safe nahi hota. Agar tumhare dost ke saath abuse ho raha hai, use dhamkaya ya blackmail kiya ja raha hai, ya woh self-harm ka soch raha hai, toh kisi adult ki help lena loyalty hai, dhokha nahi. Pehle apne dost ko bolo: 'Mujhe teri itni parwah hai ki yeh baat sirf apne tak rakhna mujhe theek nahi lagta. Chal, saath mein kisi ko batate hain.' Kisi aise adult ke paas jao jispe tum dono ko trust ho, jaise parent, teacher ya counsellor, ya 1098 (18 se kam), 181 (women), Tele-MANAS 14416, ya emergency mein 112 pe call karo. Harm karne wale insaan se khud confront mat karo, aur yeh baat doston mein mat phailao. Agli baar, secret kya hai yeh jaane bina use chhupane ka promise mat karna.
